summary: Defines a new 6LoWPAN dispatch type for route-over networks. It first targets compression of RPL data packet information: the RPL Option and the source routing header, plus an IP-in-IP technique. It can be extended for other uses. Later RFCs update it.

eli5.summary: Tiny sensors send very small messages. This is a shorthand for the extra routing notes on each message so they fit in less space.
